verdict.rationale: PostHog is explicitly open-source with a documented free Docker Compose self-hosting option under MIT license (posthog-docs-14, posthog-docs-21), which is directly relevant to an AI-native/openness-focused user. However, community evidence shows real friction with self-hosting (broken production Dockerfile causing DB setup failures) and scaling/performance concerns for self-hosted deployments at larger scale, indicating the self-host path is not seamless.
